prose: Joining InnerVerse for their first time, Tamara Sheville and Brandon Thomas are here to explore one of the most absurd deceptions in the history of psyops.

Drawing from her background in hazardous materials and real-world chemical, biological and radiation hazard response team work, Tamara is primed to deliver a powerful truth bomb about the science of nuclear fission, why it works for power plants but will never go boom, and how the evidence from Japan's supposedly nuked cities tells a different story.
As the co-host of the new Mysterious Universe podcast, Brandon Thomas brings his jovial yet razor sharp spiritual discernment to bear on the devilish details of this conspiracy.
ext: Mechanics of nuclear fission and why it can’t explode
The “nuclear shadows” phenomenon and the questions it raises
Underwater tests, mushroom clouds, and what creates those visuals
Historical inconsistencies that don’t line up with the official story
